purpose: Production context showing modular structure with removable fabric cover and separable wood base
prompt:
Industrial design production and assembly context diagram for an elderly AI companion device, technical illustration on warm cream background (#F5F0E8).

Show the device's modular structure in an exploded-assembly style, but not a full exploded view — instead show the key modular relationships:

Main composition (center): The device shown in 3 states from left to right:

State 1 (left): "Fabric Sleeve — Removable" — The cream fabric cover (#F5F0E8) shown separately, detached from the device body. It looks like a soft sock/sleeve that wraps around the upper 2/3 of the device. Show it slightly crumpled to convey softness and flexibility. An arrow indicates it slides on/off for washing.

State 2 (center): "Core Module" — The internal core without fabric or base. Shows the hard plastic shell in warm gray (#D4CFC7) with the LED ring at top, speaker grille, button mechanism, and internal PCB visible. This is the electronic heart.

State 3 (right): "Wood Base — Separable" — The light oak wood base ring (#C4A882) shown separately. Has magnetic charging contacts on top surface and anti-slip silicone pad on bottom. An arrow shows it snaps onto the core module.

Below: A small assembly sequence diagram showing: Wood Base → Core Module → Fabric Sleeve = Complete Device. Three simple icons with arrows between them.

Right side: A "Maintenance" callout showing: fabric can be hand-washed, base can be wiped with damp cloth, core module cleaned with dry cloth only.

Style: Clean technical illustration, warm tones, not cold engineering blue. Text annotations in text-charcoal (#3D3832). Humanist sans-serif. Conveys thoughtful design for maintainability and longevity.
